items.label: MA-AG civil: American First Finance LLC
items.detail: Settlement of AG allegations of deceptive lease-to-own marketing; date is the announcement date. Total is $2 million paid to the Commonwealth for restitution plus nearly $5.8 million in credits to existing accounts. Cash-only rule applied 2026-10-11: amount changed from 7,800,000 to 2,000,000; the part not counted is listed in data/manual/excluded-amounts.csv as xa-008.

excluded_amounts.reason: Release: "The settlement requires AFF to pay $2 million to the Commonwealth ... and provides nearly $5.8 million in credits to existing consumer accounts." Counted: the $2 million. Not counted: the account credits, which reduce what customers owe.
excluded_amounts.category_label: Debt relief, loan modification or account credits
